app.title: BaSyx Docker
app.subtitle: Run BaSyx servers on this computer and open them in Studio.

engine.missingText: BaSyx Docker needs Docker Desktop or Podman Desktop. Install one of them, start it, and come back here.
engine.stoppedText: Start {name} and wait until it is ready. This page notices it on its own.

list.title: Your BaSyx instances
list.emptyText: Create one in three steps. Studio downloads everything it needs and adds the instance to your infrastructures.

preset.quickText: One BaSyx server, no sign-in. Best to try things out.
preset.fullText: Repositories, registries and discovery as separate services.

access.title: Who may do what?
access.rolesText: The administrator may change everything, the viewer may only read.
access.sharingText: People own what they create and share it with others.

persistence.keepText: Shells and submodels stay when you stop or restart the instance.
persistence.ephemeralText: Good for tests and demos: every start begins with an empty server.

card.updateAvailable: A newer tested version is available.
card.notInStudio: Not in Studio yet: it is added once the instance has started.
card.orphanText: These containers belong to an instance Studio no longer knows. You can delete them.
card.missingText: The containers were removed outside Studio. Create them again; your data is still there if you kept it.
card.exportWarning: This file contains passwords and all instance data. Share it only with trusted people.

remove.title: Delete "{name}"?
remove.text: Containers are removed. If you keep the data, this entry stays so you can recreate the instance.
remove.data: Also delete the data (shells, submodels, users)
remove.infrastructure: Also remove it from Studio's infrastructures

signIn.text: Sign in to Studio with one of these users when you open the instance.
signIn.sharingHint: With sharing, AASX files loaded at startup belong to nobody: only admin sees them until admin shares them.

job.registerFailed: Studio could not add it as an infrastructure; add it by hand under Infrastructures.
job.unregisterFailed: Studio could not remove its infrastructure; remove it by hand under Infrastructures.

wizard.name: Name
wizard.nameHint: Shown in Studio, for example "Demo line".
wizard.aasx: AASX files to load at startup
wizard.topologySeparate: Registries and discovery as separate services
wizard.basePortHint: Uses this port and the next four.
wizard.exposure: Reachable from other computers in my network
wizard.exposureWarning: Anyone in your network can reach the instance. With sign-in, signing in only works on this computer.
wizard.restart: Start again when Docker or Podman starts
wizard.summaryQuick: "{name}" runs one BaSyx server on this computer.
wizard.summaryFull: "{name}" runs a BaSyx server with separate registries and discovery on this computer.
wizard.summarySecured: Users sign in through Keycloak; access follows {access}.
wizard.summaryData: Data is kept when the instance stops.
wizard.summaryEphemeral: The data is empty after every start.
wizard.summaryAasx: It loads {count} AASX file(s) at startup.
wizard.download: Downloads about {size} MB the first time.
wizard.downloadNone: Everything it needs is already downloaded.
wizard.portsInUse: These ports are used by another program: {ports}. Pick other ports under Advanced.
wizard.note_ports_reassigned: Its ports are in use here; free ports are picked instead.
wizard.note_secrets_generated: The file has no passwords; new ones are generated.
wizard.note_compose_ignored: The settings come from basyx-stack.json; changes to docker-compose.yml are not read.
wizard.note_aasx_missing: Some AASX files are missing in the file and are left out.

problem.container_engine_unavailable: Docker or Podman does not answer. Start it and try again.
problem.container_busy: Another operation is running for this instance. Wait a moment.
problem.container_port_in_use: A port this instance needs is used by another program. Change the ports under Change settings → Advanced, or close the other program.
problem.container_image_unavailable: A download failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
problem.container_disk_full: Docker or Podman has no disk space left. Delete unused images or instances and try again.
problem.container_start_failed: A part did not start: {component}. The logs may tell why.
problem.container_operation_failed: Docker or Podman refused the operation.
